snapshot.title: FBI: Site Under Federal Jurisdiction — No Restoration Authorized

fields.to: Denise Albrecht, Incident Commander; Luis Ferreira, Security & Emergency Manager; Priya Nandakumar, SCADA / IT Security Manager
fields.subject: FW: Formal Notice — Site Under Federal Jurisdiction and Control
fields.note:
This is the formal notice from the FBI Cyber Forensics Unit following the completion of their initial forensic assessment of the Orchard Standpipe site. All operational teams must adhere strictly to the conditions outlined below. No system restoration, reset, or access to control systems is authorized until a formal release is issued by the FBI.

The site remains under federal jurisdiction. Evidence must be preserved. All future actions must be coordinated through the FBI liaison.
fields.signature:
FBI Cyber Forensics Unit
Federal Bureau of Investigation
Contact: (555) 034-1101

original.to: Denise Albrecht, Incident Commander; Luis Ferreira, Security & Emergency Manager; Priya Nandakumar, SCADA / IT Security Manager
original.subject: Formal Notice — Site Under Federal Jurisdiction and Control
original.body: The FBI has completed initial forensic assessment of the Orchard Standpipe site. No further tampering has occurred. The video from CAM-13 and RTU-02 event logs have been preserved and are not to be altered or overwritten for 30 days. The site is secure and under federal jurisdiction. All future evidence handling must be coordinated through the FBI liaison (555-034-1101). The control system remains under forensic hold. No return to service or system reset is authorized until the FBI issues a formal release. All operational decisions remain with the Incident Commander, but no actions may proceed without FBI coordination.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms that the FBI has not authorized restoration. The IC must now validate that C2 and C4 are fully met before any further action. Watch for attempts to bypass the hold or initiate unauthorized resets.
